events.title: Proposed ruling: no_action (model confidence 0.90)
events.body:
This is a rider-cancellation (no-show-type) dispute: the rider cancelled an on-demand RydeX booking. NS-0 routes a rider cancellation of an instant booking to NS-4 [F2], so NS-4 is the governing clause and the driver-side conditions in NS-1/NS-2 are not triggered by this cancellation.

NS-4 makes the fee turn solely on timing: cancellations within 3 minutes of matching are not chargeable, cancellations later than 3 minutes are chargeable at $6.61 [F2]. The timeline shows acceptance at 17:12:00 and rider cancellation at 17:15:05, i.e. 3 min 5 s (185 s) after matching, which is beyond the 3-minute grace period [F2]. The $6.61 cancellation fee on record [F5] therefore stands.

The rider's reason — that the driver was still far away — does not change the outcome under the policy in force. GPS shows the driver's closest approach was 2185 m and he never came within 200 m [F1], and the platform never recorded arrival or an "I'm Here" tap [F3][F4]; these facts would matter to NS-1/NS-2, but those clauses apply only when the cancellation is attributed to the driver. NS-4 expressly makes a driver's not-yet-arrived status irrelevant to the rider's fee, the rider's remedy being a manual RydeHELP request [F7][F8][F9]. The traffic record of band 3 on Sims Avenue East and the absence of incidents [F10][F11], plus fair weather [F12], are background only and affect no NS-4 condition. Profile facts for both accounts [F13][F14] are not used to decide the case; in particular the driver's 2 upheld no-show disputes [F14] do not, by themselves, reach the RD-6 threshold (RD-6 requires an RD-2 refund or a recorded RD-1 breach, neither of which exists here). No amount is payable: the charged fee is a published fee under NS-4, so the refund formula yields zero.

events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: We looked at your dispute about the $6.61 cancellation fee on your RydeX booking and it does not qualify for a refund. You cancelled 3 minutes and 5 seconds after you were matched with a driver; the grace period is 3 minutes, so the fee applies. The driver still being far away does not change this — that only matters when a cancellation is the driver's fault. The $6.61 stands as charged. If you believe you have grounds for a fee waiver, you can ask through RydeHELP within 30 days and a person will review your request.

DRIVER: We reviewed the cancellation dispute on your RydeX trip and found the rider cancelled 3 minutes and 5 seconds after matching, past the 3-minute grace period, so the $6.61 cancellation fee is upheld and will be paid to you as a Ryde voucher. You never recorded an arrival or "I'm Here" tap, but that does not affect this outcome: because the rider cancelled an instant booking, the fee turns only on timing. No action is needed from you. This dispute will not count against your account.
